references.text: Heshbon was the city of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and taken all his land.
The continuation of the song describing Heshbon's destruction and Israel's victory over the region.
Moses refers to Israel's victory over Sihon, king of Heshbon.
Jephthah refers to Israel's struggle against Sihon, king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon.
Isaiah prophesies about the destruction of Heshbon and Moab, a similar theme of fire and judgment.
Jeremiah quotes directly from this song about the fire that goes out from Heshbon and devours Moab.
Amos uses similar imagery of fire devouring cities as God's judgment.
